sara_support: FYI customer ACME reported a big invoice delta. They say their local estimator shows ~1.1k tokens but invoice billed ~3.3k for one request. They attached curl and payload. Asking for quick triage.

devin_eng: Can you paste the payload + request_id from the invoice? Also which SDK version and whether they used streaming or non-streaming.

sara_support: They used SDK v0.9.8, streaming:true, and did a short tool call that returns a base64 blob. Request id: req_20260315_9421. Payload below:

```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, X-Client-Tokenizer: custom-ctok/1.2
Body: {
  "model": "rwd-llm-large",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Summarize attached file and return json."}
  ],
  "stream": true,
  "tool_calls": [{"name":"extract_pdf","args":{"url":"https://acme.example/largefile.pdf"}}]
}
```

sara_support: Customer says they saw streaming reconnects (network flaps) while uploading, might be relevant.

kelsey_repro: I tried a local repro: streamed the same request, killed the connection after the first few tokens, re-established the stream and resumed. Meter shows duplicated prompt tokens in the final breakdown. My quick log:

```
[client] send: prefix=system+user tokens=120
[client] stream interrupted
[client] reconnect -> re-send: prefix=system+user tokens=120
[server] produced completion chunks -> tool output appended
```

After finalization, metering trace shows prompt ~240 tokens (should be 120), completion inflated because tool output base64 was tokenized differently (large). Local SDK estimator (custom-ctok) reported 1.1k, server billed 3.3k.

metering_bot: Metering trace for req_20260315_9421: events=[initial_request, retry_stream_resume, tool_call_exec]. Token breakdown (server): "system":300, "prompt":240, "completion":2760 => total 3300. Notes: tool output size ~800KB base64, tokenized into ~2.7k tokens on our tokenizer.

michael_billing: Two things stand out: (1) streaming reconnects caused the client to re-send prompt bytes which our runtime currently attributes separately per event; (2) tool returned base64 large payload which exploded completion tokens. Combined they explain the 3x delta.

devin_eng: Hypothesis: Our metering aggregates tokens from each ingress event and does not dedupe identical prompt segments when the same request_id is re-sent after disconnect. The SDK's estimator didn't count the second send because it dedupes locally (or it reuses cached prompt). Also, custom-ctok header indicates they used a different tokenizer; tokenization differences amplify mismatch for base64 blobs.

kelsey_repro: Repro steps I used (shell):

```
# start stream
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Client-Tokenizer: custom-ctok/1.2" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions?stream=true -v
# after receiving 2 chunks: kill -9 the curl (simulate network flake)
# reopen connection and re-POST same payload with same X-Request-Id
```

I attached small runbook to reproduce. On our side the trace shows two separate `ingest.event` rows with the same request_id.

sara_support: Customer asks for next steps — refund? fix? guidance to avoid.

michael_billing: Recommend issuing a billing credit for the overage while we investigate. I'll prepare a 2.2k token credit for this invoice and mark as review. Also propose a short-term mitigation note: ask customers to avoid streaming+large tool outputs until we patch or to upgrade SDK.

devin_eng: Action items:
- infra: collapse duplicate prompt events for identical request_id within a 60s window (dedupe on content hash) — assign to eng-infra. (P1)
- runtime: add caps / warnings for tool outputs that exceed 100k bytes and mark as potentially costly (P2)
- docs/SDK: document streaming reconnect behavior and recommend SDK backoff/resume behavior to avoid re-sending prefix by default (P1)

kelsey_repro: Quick patch we tested: server-side dedupe by event-hash reduced billed prompt tokens to single send. After patch, server breakdown matched expected ~1.2k (still heavy because of base64 -> consider tool compression or streaming only metadata). Will open PR.

devin_eng: Also confirm tokenizer parity: if customer uses custom tokenizer header we should include a clear note that meter uses our tokenizer. For edge cases (base64), different tokenizers diverge strongly.

sara_support: Messaging to customer: give them the credit, recommend upgrading SDK to 0.9.9+ (includes reconnect dedupe helper) and suggest switching tool output to raw binary transfer or file reference instead of base64 in payload. I'll send draft.

michael_billing: Done — applied interim credit. Created billing ticket BILL-1157.

kelsey_repro: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — dedupe based on event content hash, unit tests included.

devin_eng: I'll schedule a runtime rollout next week. After rollout we'll backfill affected requests to adjust billed tokens if possible.

sara_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
